utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Good morning to everybody in the courtroom. Before we start with the examination of the next witness, I would like to remind the Prosecution that according to the rules about evidence, we would like to receive CDs or DVDs of the videos that we have seen now, a long list, I don't want to put it on the record, and it should be provided to the Chamber, and of course the other party as soon as possible after we have seen and received these videos. Are there any procedural matters? Thank you, Mr. Gajic, you have received them. You are in a better position. But we are very optimistic to receive them quite soon. Are there any procedural matters? In that case we go now -- we will hear the next witness in closed session according to a decision of another Chamber. Closed session, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: During today's sitting we have heard the witness in closed session because of protective measures. Now we are back in open session and the Registrar will give some information for the record.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. Pursuant to the oral decision rendered on the 29th of September, 2010, transcript page 5978, lines 5 to 6, the Registry hereby assigns exhibit number to 65 ter 06576 as P01137. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. We have to adjourn now and we will resume on Tuesday next week in the afternoon, 2.15. We adjourn.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 5th day of October, 2010, at 2.15 p.m. 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.48 p.m.,
